input.prompt:
You are a verifier for the code review. For EACH candidate below, return exactly one verdict: CONFIRMED / PLAUSIBLE / REFUTED with 1-2 sentence justification quoting decisive lines. These are cleanup/efficiency candidates — CONFIRM when the duplication/waste is factually present and the named alternative exists and works; REFUTE if the "existing helper" doesn't actually fit or the waste is imaginary. Read the actual files.

K1. Spin @keyframes duplicated 4× (checkout.tsx two <style> injections, split-payment.tsx spinKeyframes const used twice) when both files already import client/src/styles/checkout.css — one rule there would serve all.

K2. "Secured by Windcave · PCI DSS Compliant" footer JSX copy-pasted 3× (checkout.tsx quote phase + main render, split-payment.tsx) — extractable component next to TaptWordmark.

K3. checkout.tsx quote-phase branch rebuilds the page wrapper/card shell/footer that the main payment render also builds (and renderTerminal partially builds) — a shared renderPage/renderShell helper would remove the drift risk. ALSO assess: does the quote-phase → payment transition remount the card DOM (separate React trees), contradicting the 'card never remounts' intent? That elevates it beyond cleanup — report what actually happens on the transition (compare element structure/keys of the two returns).

K4. split-payment.tsx "Transaction not found" branch re-implements checkout.tsx renderTerminal (absolute wordmark top:44, minHeight 420 card) — shareable.

K5. split-payment.tsx stepperStyle re-declares checkout-theme's iconBtnStyle primitive (border/color/centering, differs only in 48px round vs 52px square) — derivable via spread.

K6. split-payment.tsx amountInputStyle duplicates checkout.tsx hfContainerStyle's white-field treatment (white bg, 1.5px rgba(4,13,109,0.18) border, navy text) — promote shared fieldSurfaceStyle to checkout-theme.ts.

K7. split-payment.tsx imports subtitleStyle from checkout-theme but never uses it.

K8. split-payment.tsx first-person vs subsequent-payer branches duplicate ~60 lines (edit-amount block + confirm/pay footer) differing only in state variable names — parameterizable.

K9. server/routes.ts resolve endpoint (~6078): new getActiveSchedule/getQuote lookups run as a second serial awaited roundtrip after the existing Promise.all([getMerchant, getCheckoutParty]) even though they only depend on `invoice` — could join the same Promise.all, saving one DB roundtrip on a latency-sensitive public endpoint.

K10. checkout.tsx quote useQuery lacks staleTime/refetchOnWindowFocus:false — every tab refocus refires the quote GET (which server-side does quote+client+merchant(+invoices) queries) for effectively immutable data. NOTE: also weigh AGAINST the separate candidate that the quote GET has a side effect (marks viewed) — refetch also re-fires that endpoint's side-effectful path; does a refocus refetch cause any harm beyond waste (e.g., during the accept transition)?

K11. server/storage.ts getJobInvoicesByQuote selects all rows/columns and routes.ts .find()s the first non-voided — a WHERE status <> 'voided' LIMIT 1 (or projection) is cheaper and centralizes the rule.

Return a JSON array: [{"id":"K1","verdict":"...","justification":"..."}, ...]
